summaries.en: OpenViking is an open-source context database that solves the challenge of managing complex information for AI agents by organizing memory, resources, and skills through a file system paradigm. Its technical innovation lies in enabling hierarchical context delivery and self-evolving capabilities, allowing agents to access and update information efficiently. Developers can integrate it into agent frameworks like OpenClaw to build more capable AI systems that learn and adapt over time through structured context management.
summaries.zh: OpenViking 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的开源上下文数据库，它通过文件系统范式统一管理智能体所需的内存、资源和技能，解决了复杂信息组织的难题。其技术核心在于支持分层上下文传递和自进化能力，使智能体能够高效访问和更新信息。开发者可以将其集成到 OpenClaw 等智能体框架中，构建能够通过结构化上下文管理持续学习和适应的更强大 AI 系统，为实际应用提供灵活、可扩展的解决方案。

summaries.en: Dimos is a Python-based dimensional framework that provides a structured approach to managing complex data relationships and transformations in AI systems. It introduces a novel dimensional abstraction layer that separates data representation from processing logic, enabling more modular and maintainable code architectures. Developers can use Dimos to build scalable data pipelines, implement custom transformations, and experiment with different dimensional representations for tasks like feature engineering, model interpretability, or multi-modal data integration.
summaries.zh: Dimos是一个基于Python的维度框架，专门解决AI系统中复杂数据关系和转换的结构化管理问题。它通过创新的维度抽象层，将数据表示与处理逻辑分离，使代码架构更加模块化和可维护。该框架的核心在于将高维数据操作封装为可组合的维度变换，让开发者能够专注于业务逻辑而非底层实现。你可以用它构建可扩展的数据流水线，实现自定义特征转换，或为多模态数据集成、模型可解释性等任务设计灵活的维度表示方案。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
